metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.6 · 1986 · No Retreat, No Surrender
metas.description: Jason, a Bruce Lee fan, sees his karate instructor/dad beaten by martial art thugs. They move to Seattle where, after humiliations, he trains with Bruce Lee's ghost so he can defend himself and others against thugs.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.1 · 1987 · No Retreat, No Surrender 2
metas.description: In this sequel, Scott Wylde, an American kickboxer, must go to Cambodia to rescue his Vietnamese girlfriend from Russian and Vietnamese troops.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.3 · 1990 · No Retreat, No Surrender 3: Blood Brothers
metas.description: Two feuding brothers (one a policeman, the other a martial arts expert) of different political views, join forces to avenge the death of their father, a retired agent, killed by the mafia.
